sourceQuote: Alternatively, one paper must be published in such a journal, and one research achievement be patented or officially approved by provincial or ministerial (or up) authority with the candidate ranked among the first 3 investigators.
targetQuote: Alternatively，须在 such 期刊发表一篇论文，且须有一项研究成果获得专利，或经省级或部委（或以上）主管部门正式批准，且申请人须位列前3名研究人员。
